description: Build the numbered V1 shot log (SH001, SH002…) from the sequence your Premiere panel shares: timeline in and out, source in and out, duration (timecode and exact ticks), source file, clip reference, and, once Describe shots has run in the panel, each shot's description, size and notes. Returns rows and a CSV with the brief's columns. No footage bytes. First call premiere_list_connections to get the deviceId of your connected Premiere panel.

deviceId.description: The id of your connected Premiere panel, from premiere_list_connections.

name: premiere_shot_log
title: Premiere Shot Log
